items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1962-01-18
items.q: The name 'Sylvester Handy' is mentioned by the Interviewer as the owner of an instrument and associated with a past band ('Handy brothers'), but the Interviewee (John Joseph) does not mention any personal interaction, relationship, or direct knowledge of Sylvester Handy in their response.

ctx.x: but I just can't think of the name now.

You want to try the man-winner? I think that's tuned up now. Maybe a little bit low, but at least it's in tune with itself. It belongs to Sylvester Handy. I guess the Handy brothers used that over in the past Christian 30 or 40 years ago when they had a band there. It wouldn't take me long. No, you'd get back on the ground again. It was a little bit of practice.

It would take me long to play something. In fact, I could play something in about half an hour. I could play almost enough to play a little dance. I could play a little violin too. You know what kind of violin play out? Years ago, people hardly knew anything about violin.
